name: translateDecimalEntityWithSemicolon
expected: Returns length consumed (5), writes 'A' (codepoint 65) to writer because it is a valid decimal numeric entity.

name: translateHexEntityLowercaseWithSemicolon
expected: Returns length consumed (6), writes 'A' (codepoint 65) to writer because it is a valid lowercase hex numeric entity.

name: translateHexEntityUppercaseWithSemicolon
expected: Returns length consumed (6), writes 'A' (codepoint 65) to writer because it is a valid uppercase hex numeric entity.

name: translateDecimalEntityWithoutSemicolon
expected: Returns length consumed (4), writes 'A' to writer because the semi-colon is optional according to Javadoc.

name: translateSupplementaryCodepoint
expected: Returns length consumed (9), writes surrogate pair characters corresponding to codepoint 0x1D306 (entityValue > 0xFFFF).

name: translateNonEntityNoAmpersand
expected: Returns 0 because index 2 starts with 'A', not '&'.

name: translateIncompleteEntityJustAmpersandHash
expected: Returns 0 because index < seqEnd - 2 condition fails (input length is 2).

name: translateIncompleteHexEntityOnlyX
expected: Returns 0 because start == seqEnd after encountering 'x' without digits.

name: translateInvalidCharactersInEntity
expected: Returns 0 because NumberFormatException is caught when parsing 'Z' as a digit/hex digit.

name: translateWithOffsetIndex
expected: Returns 5, translates the entity starting at index 3 and writes 'A' to the writer.

name: translateHexEntityWithoutSemicolon
expected: Returns length consumed (5), writes 'A' to writer because semi-colon is optional for hex entities too.

name: translateBoundaryIndexTooCloseToEnd
expected: Returns 0 because index < seqEnd - 2 is false and second char is not '#' anyway.
